reasons: Candidate is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, and otel_metric_definitions is empty, so no OTel metric can be confirmed to measure the same quantity; the block cannot be verified against the catalog.

The OTel nginx receiver may expose waiting connections as nginx.connections_current with a state attribute (e.g. state="waiting"). If that metric is defined in the catalog, an exact translation could exist and the block would be wrong; check the catalog before accepting the block.
The Datadog query is sum:nginx.connections.idle{$host} with no grouping and no formula. The $host template variable (prefix host, default *) would map to host_name=~"$host" if a translation exists.
